sources.title: AgentFlow: In-the-Flow Agentic System Optimization - GitHub
sources.snippet: AgentFlow is a trainable, tool-integrated agentic framework designed to overcome the scalability and generalization limits of today's tool-augmented reasoning approaches. Unlike prevailing approaches such as Search-R1 which train a single LLM to interleave reasoning steps with tool calls, AgentFlow introduces a modular agentic system with four specialized modules: 🧭 Planner, 🛠 Executor ...
